ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity dominance; surface consists of approximately 95% low-intensity black pixels with localized high-intensity white/grey clusters amounting to less than 5% total area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid black pigmentation across the majority of the visible surface. High-contrast white focal spots detected in the center-left lobe area. High-density white/grey mottling concentrated at both distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 115 degrees; depth is distinct and clearly divides the fluke into two symmetrical lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated boundary. The left lobe exhibits a higher frequency of sharp, sawtooth-like peaks. The right lobe exhibits broader, more irregular peaks with significant valleys toward the distal end.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the posterior boundary of both lobes, with a sharp upward sweep ending in tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white/grey pixel groups (consistent with barnacle colonization) located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 distinct, near-parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the lower right-center lobe. Multiple smaller, unaligned high-intensity scratches visible across the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of prominent vertical rake marks on the right lobe; multiple circular depigmented scars/spots on the left lobe; heavy barnacle encrustation on lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinct, circular white ring mark resembling a zero or O-shape is located on the mid-ventral surface of the left lobe.
